<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0092026-04-1409-57-37" status="unreviewed">
   <milestone unit="section" n="bsgyur lugs"/>
   bsgyur lugs la | 
<foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">a rgya</foreign> na 'phags pa'o || 
<foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">sarba</foreign> na thams cad  do| 
<foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">a ti</foreign> na yod par ro || 
<foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">bad tra</foreign> na smra bar ro || 
<foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">shra ma ne ra</foreign> na dge  tshul lo || 
<foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">ka ri ka</foreign> na tshig le'ur byas pa'o ||<note type="editorial">The text being commented upon is identified here as having the Sanskrit title Ārya-sarva-astivāda-śrāmaṇera-kārikā, in Tibetan: 'Phags pa thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa</note> </seg></TEI>
